svg.title: Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
svg.desc: Closed gaps in the dangerous-command detector of Nous Research's open-source Hermes Agent, in 3 PRs with regression tests: awk -F in a cron job no longer gets blocked, a hidden Unicode variation selector is flagged, and a credential upload under an approved pipe-to-shell rule now asks first.
svg.text: Closed gaps in Hermes’ security layer that decides
which shell commands an open-source AI agent may run
PRs to the command guard, each with regression tests
